verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents that it handles JS-heavy pages, can return HTML output, and can extract dynamic content. However, no evidence states that the HTML it returns is the fully rendered post-JavaScript DOM of a single-page application, so this is credited as partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation that HTML output is the fully rendered DOM after JS execution, SPA-specific rendering controls (e.g. wait-for-render or selectors), independent or hands-on confirmation of rendered-HTML output for SPAs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can render JavaScript-heavy single-page applications and get the fully rendered HTML

citations.quote: Covers 96% of the web, including JS-heavy pages
